svg.title: One exchange in one NVLink domain: Masked DeepEP and afdEP v1
svg.desc: Two swimlane flowcharts, Attention GPUs and FFN GPUs, through initialization, dispatch, copy epilogue, expert GEMM, combine and reduce epilogue. Masked DeepEP registers a union window, runs an all-rank barrier at the entry and exit of dispatch and of combine, exchanges counts with every rank and runs every kernel on every rank. afdEP v1 lays the same window out by role, sends counts from Attention to FFN only, runs no all-rank barrier (each phase receiver waits for its senders per-CTA arrivals), starts the FFN copy epilogue at the counts, and runs each epilogue only on the role that needs it.
svg.text: One exchange in one NVLink domain, step by step
2 Attention + 2 FFN GPUs on the same DeepEP V2 transport; the roles decide what each rank registers, who counts, who waits and which kernels run.
Union window: a region per rank in every inbox; count slots for every
rank and logical expert, Attention's dummy expert slots included
Same size on every rank (the window is symmetric), laid out by role:
50% of the union window at 2A2F; regions shown are the ones written
send zero counts to every rank
send counts to FFN ranks only
no exit barrier: only the FFN ranks wait
Expert GEMM (e.g. DeepGEMM), run by the caller

one FFN rank: a zero-copy view
